profile.summary: Strategic Inquiry Consulting is a company that works with schools to build teacher team leadership. Its model helps teachers find students who are falling behind, work out which skills those students are missing, and plan targeted help. It also works on school systems and spreads the approach across school staff. It has worked with schools in New York City and other places.
